description: This file contains CMake functions and macros for configuring header-only libraries and packages, handling template files, and generating configuration files for CMake and pkg-config. It defines functions to facilitate installation and configuration of header-only modules in a CMake-based project.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Configures and installs a header-only library's CMake configuration, handling dependencies and generating config files.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Generates and installs a pkg-config file for a header-only package, including compile options and include paths.
